_about: Advertised offers read from each business's own site. One row per listing. valid_until is the end date the site states, or empty when it states none (Offers\sweep removes a row the day after it ends; re-check undated rows monthly). The structured fields (kind, price, basis, includes, eligibility, terms) are what the listing card shows -- only state what the site states; price is a display string, never computed. Set removed:true to clear a row. Applied by tools/apply-offers.php.
